title: BandParityTower: a Lean 4 formalization of the band-parity tower and its limit modulo eight
description:
Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization accompanying J. S. Farland, "The band-parity tower and its limit modulo eight, formalized in Lean" (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23752472). It covers: the cyclotomic tower and the band-parity tower f_a ≡ m (mod 4) at every odd prime; the doubling count, the imaginary law e_a ≡ 2N_a - m (mod 4) and its forms at levels two and three; the collapse, and E. Lehmer's criterion for 2 to be a 2k-th power residue; the power-map family, the companion law at p ≡ 1 (mod 8), and Lehmer-type invariants of the inversion map; modulo 8: the joint-parity form, the dichotomy, squaring cycles, the defect lemma, odd multipliers, and the fifth-interval formula.

The statements are in Challenge.lean. Lean's comparator checks them against the proofs, with the definition bodies compared, and the proofs are replayed in the Lean, nanoda and con-ron kernels. No sorry, no native_decide; standard axioms only. The changes in each version are described in the release notes on GitHub: github.com/jkfarland-bot/Bandparitytower/releases.
notes: AI assistance: the Lean code in this record was drafted and repaired by Claude (Anthropic), an AI model, from the statements and proofs of the companion paper "The band-parity tower and its limit modulo eight, formalized in Lean" (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23752472), and compiled locally with lake. Every proof is checked by the Lean kernel, and Comparator replays the solution against the statement file under the Lean, NanoDa and con-ron kernels. The author, Joseph S. Farland, chose the scope, directed the work, and is responsible for the contents. No external human reviewer has checked the formalization.
